studyDesign.note: Latest V2.1 full balance matrix with player-attribute tactical adaptation, high-quality synthetic squads averaging 92+ overall, 10 workers, 180 chains per match, and compact separated output for an approximately six-hour run.

playerQuality.note: Synthetic high-quality player pool; no real player accounts. Position-specific source attributes are retained and lifted to elite overall.

realismBenchmarks.reference: Candidate validation envelope after deep-defense attacking commitment, counter outlet scarcity, midfield-vacuum possession loss and structural long-shot exposure. Both sides use symmetric rules with no home advantage.
